name: use-debounce
title: useDebounce
description: Debounced value and debounced callback: wait for input to settle before acting.
a11y: No DOM output. Use for search fields so the list updates after typing stops.
A pending callback is dropped on unmount.

props.name: call
props.description: Schedules `fn` to run `delay` ms after the last call.

props.name: cancel
props.description: Drops the pending call, if any.
